definitions.explanation: A clipped form of クレジットカード. It belongs to casual speech, chat, and online writing; formal documents, shop signage, and staff speaking to customers all use the full クレジットカード.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クレカ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently that shop doesn't take credit cards.

examples.japanese: クレカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked at my credit card statement, I'd spent too much this month.

notes:
A clipping of ⟦クレジット→クレジット：10826_kurejitto⟧ + ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ that keeps the front of each part, the same abbreviating pattern as ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧ (⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧) and ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧ (パーソナル⟦コンピューター→コンピューター：01530_konpyuutaa⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クレカ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay by credit card
- クレカ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: credit cards are accepted
- クレカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to get a credit card issued
- クレカ{払|ばら}い: payment by credit card

REGISTER:
Casual only. Say ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧ in a shop, on a form, or in any business setting; クレカ is for friends, family, and informal writing.
